classification.difficultyReason: Apply addition and subtraction to a shared perimeter, including decimal measurements and two occurrences of an unknown side. This is the closest supplied addition-and-subtraction skill.

content.prompt:
All of these shapes have perimeter 50 cm. Find the lengths of the missing sides.

All lengths are given in centimetres.

spec.description: Upright triangle with external dimension arrows: left side 19, right side 17, horizontal base a. Decorative orange fill removed.
spec.mathematics: The three side lengths sum to 50 cm. Drawing coordinates preserve source appearance and are not additional measurements.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied measurements and the unknown a are visible.

spec.description: Slanted quadrilateral with external dimension arrows: top 14.2, left 14.3, right 12.9, bottom b. No parallel or equal-side markings. Decorative green fill removed.
spec.mathematics: Use all four side labels and the stated perimeter. The source silhouette does not supply parallelogram properties.
spec.answerVisibility: The unknown b remains unsolved; the teacher result is stored only in the answer.

spec.description: Horizontal rectangle with external dimension arrows. Both horizontal sides are labelled 18 and both vertical sides c. Decorative purple fill removed.
spec.mathematics: The two unknown sides share the same label. Subtract both 18 cm sides from 50 cm, then divide the remainder by two.
spec.answerVisibility: Both c labels remain visible without their value.

answer.worked:
The two sides labelled $c$ share the remaining perimeter equally.

$$\begin{align*}c&=(50-18-18)\div2\\&=14\div2\\&=7\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Triangle with its apex above and near the left end of its horizontal base. External dimension arrows label the left side 17.3, base 18.9 and descending right side d. Decorative ochre fill removed.
spec.mathematics: All three sides sum to the stated 50 cm perimeter.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given lengths and unknown d appear.

spec.description: Pentagon with top apex and horizontal bottom. External dimension arrows label upper-left 7.9, upper-right 7.9, lower-left 11.6, bottom 7.9 and lower-right e. Decorative yellow fill removed.
spec.mathematics: Retain all three 7.9 cm givens; the five sides sum to 50 cm.
